scene: The musical automaton dispenses a glowing brass key with cheerful musical chimes.
picture: A flat side view along the rooftop platform. On the far left, a mechanical accordion automaton sits with a glowing brass key in its outstretched palm. In the centre, the grandmother in pink tracksuit stands holding her small white dog on a lead. On the far right, an open spiral staircase winds upward.
